# Exam Seating Manager

Internal tool for Crusoe College (Victorian secondary school). Manages exam
seating for NAPLAN and other exam sessions. Used by exam coordinators (editors)
and general teaching staff (view-only).

## Build & test

```bash
node build.js      # regenerates Exam_Seating_Manager.html from src/
python3 test.py    # 99 Playwright checks against the built file (needs node too)
```

Always run both after a change. `test.py` needs `playwright install chromium`
once.

## The one rule

**Never edit `Exam_Seating_Manager.html` directly.** It is generated by
`build.js` from `src/`. A hand-edit there is silently lost on the next build.
Edit the matching `src/part*.js` file instead, then rebuild.

The single-file output is deliberate: staff open it from a link with nothing
installed, so there is no bundler, no npm install, and no external runtime
dependency beyond two CDN scripts (Google Fonts, SheetJS).

## Where things live

| File | Holds |
|---|---|
| `src/part1_head.html` | All CSS, page shell, nav, modal markup |
| `src/part2_core.js` | `CONFIG`, `DEFAULT_CONFIG` + `migrateDB()`, state, sync layer, editor mode, modal, router |
| `src/part3_sessions.js` | Sessions, students, Excel/CSV import |
| `src/part4_rooms_seating.js` | Rooms, templates, seating engine, seat grid |
| `src/part6_settings.js` | Settings tab: branding, room types, statuses, defaults, print |
| `src/part7_files.js` | Save to file / Open file (whole-plan backups) |
| `src/part5_lookup_print_help.js` | Lookup, print sheets, how-to guides, seed, boot (built last) |
| `src/seed.json` | Local-mode demo data (Year 9 NAPLAN 2026 layout, **fictional names**) |
| `Code.gs` | Google Apps Script backend — the authoritative API contract |
| `test_backend.js` | Test-only: real `Code.gs` on a fake in-memory Sheet |
| `test_baseline.json` | Seats + print HTML from the original app; defaults must match it |

## Privacy — this folder is published

This folder lives in the **public** `crusoeapps/compassaddons` repo and is
served on its public GitHub Pages site (deliberately left out of the Compass
Tools menu and home page). So:

- **No real student data in the repo, ever** — not in `seed.json`, test
  fixtures, screenshots or docs. The seed names are made up.
- **Never commit a non-blank `CONFIG.API_URL`.** Backend reads need no
  password, so a public page with the URL would expose every student's name.
  Shared mode belongs in a privately hosted copy.
- Plan files from "Save to file" contain real names: never commit one.

## Invariants — do not break these

- **`Code.gs` defines the data schema.** The app maps to it in `roomToRow`,
  `rowToRoom`, `studentToRow`, `rowToStudent`. Changing the schema means
  changing those four functions *and* `Code.gs` together.
- **Keep the version round-trip on saves.** Each session carries a `version`; a
  stale save returns `VERSION_CONFLICT` and prompts a reload. This is what stops
  one coordinator silently overwriting another. Do not "simplify" it away.
- **`routeStudent()` is the only place that decides room placement.** It reads
  the status → room-type rules from Settings. Anything that changes a status
  must call it. Never hard-code a status label (`'Completing'`) — use
  `isSeatedStatus()`, `statusPurpose()` and friends.
- **Default settings reproduce the original app exactly.** `test.py` compares
  against `test_baseline.json`. Only regenerate it for a deliberate change.
- **Sheet columns are append-only.** New columns go at the end of a tab in
  `SHEETS`; `setup()` rewrites header rows so existing sheets pick them up.
- **Settings saves are version-checked too** (`saveSettings` /
  `VERSION_CONFLICT`). Same rule as sessions: never remove it.
- **`migrateDB()` runs on every load and must stay idempotent.** New fields get
  their default there.
- **Printing uses a hidden iframe, not `window.open()`**, which is blocked in
  sandboxed previews and some locked-down school browsers.
- **Every `localStorage` access goes through `lsGet`/`lsSet`** — it throws
  outright in some embedded contexts, so both are wrapped in try/catch.
- **Everything user-facing passes through `esc()`** before reaching `innerHTML`.
- **View-only mode is enforced, not cosmetic.** Editor controls are gated on the
  `is-editor` body class *and* guarded in the handlers (`if (!editor) return`).
  Keep both.

## Conventions

- ES5-style `function` and `var` throughout, for tolerance on older school SOE
  browsers. `async`/`await` appears only where the code talks to the backend
  (sync layer, settings save, opening plan files).
- User-facing copy is plain English for non-technical staff: say what happened
  and what to do next. Never surface a raw error code on its own.
- Two runtime modes: blank `CONFIG.API_URL` means local mode (localStorage +
  `seed.json`); a URL means the Apps Script backend. `remote()` is the switch —
  every write path must handle both.

## Testing gap

`test.py` cannot cover Excel/CSV import: the SheetJS CDN is unreachable in a
sandbox, so those requests fail and are filtered out of the error assertion.
**After touching `readImportFile` or `doImport`, test the import by hand** with
a real .xlsx.

The suite also asserts the Year 9 seed counts (218 students, 212 in GYM). If you
change `seed.json`, update those numbers in `test.py` and regenerate
`test_baseline.json`.

Shared mode is tested against the real `Code.gs` via `test_backend.js`, but
that fake Sheet stores values exactly as given — real Sheets turns some strings
into numbers or dates. After changing `Code.gs`, also try it in a real Sheet.
